Because shipping-sensitive cart abandoners comprise only 3% of the customer base, capturing 100% of them yields at most a +3.0% conversion lift, leaving a 2.12% deficit. Spending the merchant's single scarce experiment on an intervention mathematically guaranteed to destroy net contribution is unjustifiable.
